parameters.name: ApplyId
parameters.description: The application batch ID of the devices to query. You can obtain the application batch ID from the response of the [BatchImportDevice](~~433878~~) operation.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50.
